parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the permission policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length.

parameters.name: PolicyDocument
parameters.description:
The document of the policy.

The document must be 1 to 6,144 characters in length.

parameters.name: PolicyName
parameters.description:
The name of the permission policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcemanager create-policy --policy-name OSS-Administrator --description 'OSS管理员权限' --policy-document Statement_:_Action_:_oss:0_,_Effect_:_Allow_,_Resource_:_acs:oss:0:0:0_,_Version_:_1 --api-version 2020-03-31 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcemanager CreatePolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Description 'OSS管理员权限' --PolicyName 'OSS-Administrator' --PolicyDocument 'Statement_:_Action_:_oss:0_,_Effect_:_Allow_,_Resource_:_acs:oss:0:0:0_,_Version_:_1'
